page_title: Official Latest NFL Injury Report for Players - Week 10 of the 2026 Season | NFL.com
method: fetch_page tool, chunks 0-7 (totalChunks=8, hasMore=false on chunk 7) read in full; every player row transcribed into injury_week10_2026-11-18.psv by hand, then compared row by row against data/injuries_week10_2026.csv by script
fetch_timestamp_note: The fetch tool returns no per-request timestamp. The read is bounded by the session clock at transcription; chunk reads occurred in the minutes before this time.
raw_bytes_note: The fetch tool returns processed markdown, not the HTTP response body, so no hash of the server's raw bytes exists. The hash below covers the transcription file only.
prior_register: data/injuries_week10_2026.csv as of commit bd4f469 (345 rows, read 2026-11-14)
page_records_note: Team records printed on the page (for example NE (5-5), DET (7-2)) are post-game records, not the pre-game records in data/games_week10_2026.csv.
page_news_note: The page's NEWS block lists headlines dated through Tuesday, Nov. 17; the Week 11 injury report is not shown on this read.
